name: autoexec_job_exec
label: Job Real-Time Execution Records
description: Real-time execution records of jobs, used to determine if there are ongoing processes. They can be used for time dimension statistical analysis and query association in automated reporting scenarios.

fields.name: job_id
fields.description: Job ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: runner_map_id
fields.description: Runner ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: exec_id
fields.description: Execution ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the job_id, runner_map_id, exec_id fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
